game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard, an echoing courtyard: the relic hunter must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Echoing Courtyard: an echoing courtyard
core_gameplay_loop: In Echoing Courtyard, repeat each round: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the convoy_size value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about convoy_size to power up the relic hunter and open the obelisk.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Merge Convoy
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Echoing Courtyard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how convoy_size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Echoing Courtyard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
